variables.observationVariableName: Pixel count in lateral root(s) (filter F448)

method.description: Archived PSI fluorescence TAR files are unpacked to a single .dumm image, which is then horizontally flipped and aligned to the backlit-mask reference frame with filter- and unit-specific geometry presets. The same ROI quantification code is applied after alignment regardless of assay interpretation: transferred ROI masks are used to compute mean fluorescence, summed fluorescence, and ROI pixel count. The HADES FluorCam units are bottom-view systems for square Petri dishes with a 12.36 MP monochrome CMOS sensor, multichannel LED excitation, and motorized emission filter wheels.

variables.observationVariableName: Emission spectrum mean in peri-root region (349.9nm-899.1nm)

method.description: VNIR hyperspectral cubes acquired under 365 nm UV excitation are dark-corrected, spectrally smoothed, spatially denoised, horizontally flipped, and padded before ROI transfer. Root and peri-root masks are aligned to the cube using reference bands derived from leaf and root contrast, after which wavelength-resolved spectra are exported as ROI-level mean, sum, and standard-deviation vectors. In HADES, VNIR fluorescence emission corresponds to the internal VNIR2 workflow.

variables.observationVariableName: Seed area (px/mm2)

method.description: Image-based seed descriptor emitted by the integrated Boxeed module during pre-sowing seed phenotyping. The HADES preparation table uses a PSI-integrated Boxeed seeder for automated seed handling and stores vendor-reported seed descriptors for downstream use; the exact internal derivation algorithm is not publicly specified. This variable preserves the vendor-reported seed area quantity and unit label.
